intent_text: fix(federation): improve error handling (#18718) * fix(federation): improve error handling This improves the error handling of the federation. Fixed the following issues: - Crash when omitting `__typename` - Crash when providing an unsupported field - Crash when providing an unsupported type - Was overriding non-field attributes (e.g., `__name__`) - Crash when providing an invalid ID (e.g., an int) - Crash when omitting the field `id` or providing `null` - Crash when omitting `representations` or passing `null` It also removes a redundant loop in `build_federated_schema()`. * fix: crash when providing invalid type
